definitions.explanation: The physical energy and endurance of the body.

examples.japanese: {体力|たいりょく}が{落|お}ちた。
{体力|たいりょく}{勝負|しょうぶ}になる。
examples.english: It becomes a test of endurance.

examples.japanese: {年|とし}を{取|と}ると{体力|たいりょく}がなくなってくる。
examples.english: As you get older, you lose your physical strength.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}ジョギングをして{体力|たいりょく}をつけたおかげで、{長|なが}い{時間|じかん}{歩|ある}いても{疲|つか}れなくなった。
examples.english: Thanks to building up my stamina by jogging every morning, I no longer get tired even after walking for a long time.

notes:
{体力|たいりょく} refers to overall physical strength, stamina, and fitness — the body's capacity for exertion and endurance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {体力|たいりょく}をつける: to build up stamina
- {体力|たいりょく}がある/ない: to have/lack stamina
- {体力|たいりょく}が{落|お}ちる: stamina declines
- {体力|たいりょく}{測定|そくてい}: physical fitness test
- {体力|たいりょく}{的|てき}に: physically (in terms of stamina)
- {体力|たいりょく}{勝負|しょうぶ}: a contest of endurance

RELATED 〜{力|りょく} WORDS:
- {筋力|きんりょく}: muscular strength
- {持久力|じきゅうりょく}: endurance
- {気力|きりょく}: mental strength, willpower
- {泳力|えいりょく}: swimming ability
- {学力|がくりょく}: academic ability

The pair {体力|たいりょく}と{気力|きりょく} (physical and mental strength) is commonly used together.
